title: DailySalesReceipt
description: What HQ did with one DailySalesSummary record. Written by HQ to the branch's receipt topic, one receipt per summary record (a replayed dead letter gets another receipt for the same record).

branchCode.description: The branch whose cluster the summary was read from.

sourceOffset.description: Offset of the summary record in branch-sales.daily-summary (one partition). Always present, also for records that are not valid JSON.

eventId.description: eventId of the summary, when it could be read.

saleDate.description: saleDate of the summary, when it could be read.

revision.description: revision of the summary, when it could be read.

outcome.description: INSERTED, UPDATED: stored. DUPLICATE: same revision already stored (R5). STALE: a higher revision is stored (R6). REJECTED: failed a contract check, kept in the HQ dead_letter table.

storedRevision.description: Revision HQ holds for (branchCode, saleDate) after this record. Present unless outcome is REJECTED.

rejectReason.description: Present when outcome is REJECTED. See README.md, Validation layers.

detail.description: Human-readable reason, when outcome is REJECTED.
